items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Fleet-doctor has no run or findings, and operations has no deploy, uptime, or error sweep results. Authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness are unevidenced. TLS has no recorded certificate expiring within 30 days, but coverage is incomplete and does not constitute clearance. Compliance reports 20 failed and 6 unknown sites. Recommendation: block security-sensitive releases and new public exposure; permit ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. This is risk triage, not proof of compromise or certification.

Exact decision: maintain the existing private and preview-only launch gates. Continue only bounded read-only evidence capture using authorized metadata and retained artifacts. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, deploy, add dependencies, expand data collection, or conduct external outreach. Reconsider only after dated evidence covers access boundaries, secrets, isolation, release/deploy controls, dependencies, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and security.txt or disclosure readiness, with owner-approved disposition.

items.title: Maintain evidence-needed security disposition and private launch gates
items.summary: Keep new public exposure and security-sensitive releases blocked because fleet-doctor and operations evidence are unavailable and material security controls remain unevidenced. Permit ordinary reversible growth only within existing consent, disclosure, data-handling, provenance, claims, and platform-policy boundaries.
items.requested_action: Continue the consolidated read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated evidence, unknowns, affected scope, owners, severity, and release implications for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, container isolation, release and deployment controls, TLS, dependency and supply-chain risk, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, and security.txt or disclosure readiness. Do not request duplicate telemetry or mutate production.
